blocks.text: Jab gas ki halat mein koi unsur bohat zyada darja hararat tak garam kiya jaye ya us mein se barqi discharge guzari jaye to kuch makhsoos wavelengths ki shuaein (radiation) kharij hoti hain. Is radiation ke spectrum mein rangdar lakeerein hoti hain aur yeh atomic emission spectrum hai. Jab safed roshni ki beam thandi halat mein unsur ke gas namoone se guzarti hai to kuch wavelengths jazb (absorb) ho jati hain, aur jazb hone wali wavelengths siyah lakeeron ki soorat mein nazar aati hain: atomic absorption spectrum. Absorption spectrum ki siyah lakeeron ki wavelengths bilkul wahi hain jo emission spectrum ki rangdar lakeeron ki.

blocks.alt: (a) Hydrogen ka emission spectrum: gehre grey patte par chaar rangeen lakeerein, banafshi, neeli-banafshi, neeli-hari aur surkh. (b) Hydrogen ka absorption spectrum: banafshi se surkh tak musalsal rang, jin par unhi jagahon par chaar siyah lakeerein. Neeche 400 nm se 700 nm ka paimana.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: (a) hydrogen ka atomic emission spectrum (b) hydrogen ka atomic absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar (a) mein garam hydrogen sirf chaar rangon ki roshni deti hai. Neeche (b) mein safed roshni thandi hydrogen se guzarti hai to bilkul unhi chaar jagahon par roshni jazb ho kar siyah lakeerein reh jati hain. Paimane par yeh lakeerein 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par hain. Kitab ki figure mein lakeerein apne hi 400-700 nm paimane se hat kar chhapi hain (maslan surkh lakeer taqreeban 620 nm par); yahan har lakeer apni sahi wavelength par hai.

Har unsur ke electrons ki tarteeb munfarid (unique) hai aur is liye us ke muqarrar energy levels ka set bhi munfarid hai. Is liye jab electrons ek energy level se doosre mein chhalang lagate hain to jazb ya kharij hone wali radiation ki wavelengths aur frequencies bhi munfarid honi chahiyein, to har unsur ka apna makhsoos spectrum hai aur usi se us ki pehchan hoti hai: atomic spectra anasir ki unglion ke nishan (fingerprints) hain.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen, helium, neon, sodium aur mercury ke emission spectra, har ek grey patta jis par rangeen lakeerein hain, surkh baen taraf. Hydrogen ki lakeeron par 656 nm, 486 nm, 434 nm aur 410 nm likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Spectrometer se banaye gaye mukhtalif anasir ke spectral series (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Absorption spectrum ki siyah lakeerein bilkul emission spectrum ki roshan lakeeron ki wavelengths par kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono atom ke ek hi muqarrar energy levels se aati hain. Emission mein electron oonche level se neeche girta hai aur theek us energy farq ka photon deta hai; absorption mein electron usi energy ka photon le kar ulti chhalang lagata hai. Wahi levels, wahi farq, wahi wavelengths.

items: Emission spectrum: garam ya barqi josh-zada gas se rangdar lakeerein. Absorption spectrum: siyah lakeerein jahan thandi gas safed roshni jazb karti hai; wahi wavelengths (hydrogen: 656, 486, 434, 410 nm).
Har unsur ke muqarrar energy levels use munfarid spectrum dete hain, us ka fingerprint.
